title: Kagome Hofstadter butterfly
plain: The Harper model on the square lattice has a Cantor spectrum for every irrational flux. Prove the same for electrons hopping on the kagome lattice.
math: Let $H_\alpha$ be the nearest-neighbour magnetic Laplacian on the kagome lattice for a uniform magnetic field with flux $2\pi\alpha$ through each unit cell. Prove that $\sigma(H_\alpha)$ is a Cantor set for every irrational $\alpha$.
